profile.summary: Frontline Catalysts is a youth-focused climate justice organization based in East Oakland. It runs youth leadership programs that combine cultural healing, ethnic studies and hands-on climate action to help young people from underserved communities become environmental leaders.

review.notes: Exact distinctive name, Oakland location and EIN 86-3102192 confirmed on the org's site and ProPublica (501(c)(3)); youth climate/ethnic studies education fits a no-cost classroom programs agreement, though no source names OUSD directly. Contact fields are generic business details; summary is neutral and supported by the site.
